scope: Local software and illustrative logical-noise sensitivity only; no provider, hardware, backend, account, cloud job, credentials or calibration claims.
gate: All135B endpoints independently audited, selected checkpoints committed and root release before this diagnostic capsule. Never select or change models from its outcomes.

fixtures.selection: 32 validation records with smallest numeric record IDs, ascending; label independent. Same records for all methods/seeds. No test data. Preserve IDs and coordinates.

ideal: All45 selected checkpoints: compare independent matrix, production and Qiskit Aer ideal probabilities on all32 fixtures. Absolute tolerance2e-12. No threshold-failure for predeclared ambiguity band; preserve raw classes.

compile.selection: All32 fixtures per45checkpoint. Record input and compiled depth, gate counts and CX counts. Compare compiled ideal probability to original with2e-12 tolerance. Fully connected abstract2qubit target, no hardware mapping claim.

noise_semantics: Aer density-matrix depolarizing_error(p,1) after each logical RY/RZ (including encoding and final readout rotation), depolarizing_error(p,2) after each CX. Obtain premeasurementP1; apply symmetric readout analytically p_observed=r+(1-2r)*p1. These are fixed logical-gate scenarios, not noise on the compiled target and not measured device noise.

finite_shot.sampling: Independent binomial(shots,p_observed)/shots using NumPy PCG64 SeedSequence([490101,population_index,training_seed,method_index,scenario_index,shots,replicate_index]); indices zero-based in registered orders. Store every probability. This models independent binary shots conditional on density probability, not actual device execution.

aer_measured_smoke.method: Actual local Aer measured circuits, same logical noise plus ReadoutError. Retain counts, compare with density expected probability; diagnostic standardized residuals, no accuracy-selection gate or arbitrary stochastic pass/fail.

outputs: Per-circuit matrix/ideal/compiled/noisy probabilities, work/depth counts, finite-shot probabilities, actual local Aer counts and timings, environment/source/protocol hashes. Aggregate mean/max absolute distortion from ideal, class-disagreement fractions and finite-shot variability. Optional fixture F1 explicitly32-record diagnostic, not full validation/test performance.
limitations: Logical-noise choices arbitrary and predeclared; simulator speed is not hardware speed.32 label-independent validation records perpopulation and reused training-seed checkpoints support capsule checks, not broad accuracy or advantage claims. No post-result scenario tuning.
